title: Differential Harnack Estimates and Frequency Monotonicity for Filtration Equations on Riemannian Manifolds
summary: In this work we derive local differential Harnack estimates for positive solutions of filtration equations on complete Riemannian manifolds with a lower Ricci curvature bound by using Nash--Moser iteration. Inspired by earlier work on parabolic frequency functions, we establish some new frequency monotonicity formulas for these equations. The results cover the porous-medium and fast-diffusion equations, as well as several non-power diffusion laws.
